2609.18916.title: Higher-order pruning of experts in mixture-of-experts language models
2609.18916.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models suffer from large parameter counts, which create a significant memory bottleneck. Expert pruning is the most direct approach for reducing this parameter count, yet existing methods make pruning decisions for each expert independently, and assume experts' contributions are purely additive. In reality, expert usage in MoEs is inherently cooperative. We derive HOPE (Higher-Order Pruning of Experts), a second-order pruning objective which provably minimizes an upper bound on the error resulting from pruning. We show that REAP (a state-of-the-art first-order pruning method) is a special case of HOPE where interaction terms are ignored. Across three frontier MoE models (up to 122B parameters), two distinct calibration sets, and multiple benchmarks (including math, instruction following, coding, and an agentic suite), we demonstrate that HOPE produces better pruning decisions than existing methods, and its advantage is most pronounced at high pruning rates and on challenging agentic workloads. At 50% pruning, HOPE outperforms all baselines and achieves an average rank of 1.58 out of 5 methods (versus 2.42 for the next-best method, REAP), with gains of up to +6.1% on agentic coding. Over all conditions, HOPE again achieves the best average rank and surpasses every other method in the majority of head-to-head comparisons. By preserving cooperative expert structure that first-order methods ignore, HOPE enables aggressive compression with minimal degradation, particularly on complex tasks where diverse expert combinations are invoked over long sequences.
2609.18916.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）語言模型面臨著龐大的參數數量，這造成了顯著的記憶體瓶頸。專家修剪是減少這一參數數量的最直接方法，但現有的方法對每個專家的修剪決策是獨立進行的，並假設專家的貢獻是純粹相加的。實際上，MoE中的專家使用本質上是協作的。我們推導出HOPE（高階專家修剪），這是一種二階修剪目標，能夠明確最小化由修剪引起的錯誤的上界。我們展示了REAP（最先進的一階修剪方法）是HOPE的一個特例，其中忽略了交互項。在三個前沿的MoE模型（最多122B參數）、兩個不同的校準集和多個基準（包括數學、指令跟隨、編碼和代理套件）中，我們證明HOPE產生的修剪決策優於現有方法，其優勢在高修剪率和具有挑戰性的代理工作負載中最為明顯。在50%的修剪下，HOPE超越了所有基準，並在5種方法中達到了平均排名1.58（相比之下，下一最佳方法REAP為2.42），在代理編碼上獲得了高達+6.1%的增益。在所有條件下，HOPE再次達到了最佳的平均排名，並在大多數一對一比較中超越了其他所有方法。通過保留一階方法所忽略的協作專家結構，HOPE使得在複雜任務上進行激進壓縮成為可能，並且在長序列中調用多樣的專家組合時，降級最小。
